status_detail: The four-case covered projection byte-matches Ghidra 12.0.4: possibleParam's raw entry-list iteration (>= 0 acceptance, no minSize gate, join entries reachable through the per-piece join walk, cross-space ram query offset 4 accepted) and assumedExtension's space-aware cc:377 gate (foreign-space numerically-justified query -> CPUI_COPY), cc:376 join guard, sz gates, list minSize skip, both container shapes and the cc:389-393 flag precedence. Overall remains UNTESTED because big-endian space rows are unreachable (the transitional enum AddressSpace is little-endian only, ADDRESS-0001) and the remaining spaceless justified_contain callers (unjustified_container cc:1411, ParamListStandard::fillin_map cc:1382-1410) are outside this fixture's closure.

comparand.rust_crate_tree_hash_scheme: sha256 of rugra-fspec-possibleparam-base-overlay-v1 plus base commit and sorted length-prefixed paths and contents

architecture.spaces: constant=0, other=1, unique=2, ram=3, register=4, stack=5, join=6; byte addressed, wordsize 1, all little-endian
architecture.space_construction: FixtureTranslate/AddrSpace inserts ConstantSpace, OtherSpace, UniqueSpace and three IPTR_PROCESSOR AddrSpaces (ram index 3, register index 4, stack index 5) with AddrSpace::hasphysical; JoinSpace index 6 is constructed for the join ParamEntry spaceids

compiler_spec.prototype_xml: no cspec decode; staged ParamEntry resources (plain_out_entries: reg [0x200,0x207] min4 exclusion force-left + reg [0x1000,0x100F] min4 align8 + ram [0x2000,0x200F] min2 exclusion force-left; join_out_entries: join reg:0x104+reg:0x100 min4 plus plain reg [0x200,0x207] min4; cross_space_join: join ram:0x200+reg:0x200 min4; assumed_extension: reg [0x100,0x11F] min2 align8 smallsize-zext + join reg:0x204+reg:0x200 min2 smallsize-sext + ram [0x2000,0x200F] min2 exclusion smallsize-inttype + reg [0x3000,0x3007] min2 exclusion smallsize-sext + reg [0x4000,0x4007] min2 exclusion zext|inttype + reg [0x5000,0x5007] min2 exclusion inttype|sext)
compiler_spec.calling_convention: hand-built ParamEntry/ParamListStandardOut/JoinRecord via the staged loader (C++ direct field writes under the class->struct access hack, Rust pub builder setters + set_join_pieces); populateResolver is intentionally NOT called — possibleParam and assumedExtension never touch the resolver

analysis_options.api: Direct production ParamListStandardOut::possibleParam and ParamListStandard::assumedExtension calls on both sides; no Action, Rule, PrintC or Funcdata pipeline
analysis_options.model_state: case1: three plain output entries, 10 (space,offset,size) queries; case2: join + overlapping plain entry, 6 queries; case3: cross-space join, 5 queries; case4: six entries (aligned zext / join sext / ram inttype / sext / zext|inttype / inttype|sext), 13 queries
analysis_options.normalization: None. possibleParam rows print true/false verbatim; assumedExtension rows print get_opname (COPY/INT_ZEXT/INT_SEXT/PIECE — no CPUI_ prefix on either side) and, for non-COPY rows only, the res container as space:0xoffset/size
analysis_options.random_seed: none; construction and queries are deterministic
analysis_options.error_injection: none; all queries stay on valid inputs

input_manifest.canonicalization: SHA-256 of UTF-8 json.dumps({architecture, compiler_spec, analysis_options, cases}, sort_keys=True, separators=(',',':'), ensure_ascii=False)

cases.setup: ParamListStandardOut with three plain entries (reg [0x200,0x207] min4 exclusion force-left, reg [0x1000,0x100F] min4 alignment 8, ram [0x2000,0x200F] min2 exclusion force-left), NO populateResolver
cases.expect: fspec.cc:1765-1774 iterates the raw entry list with no minSize gate and accepts any justifiedContain >= 0: unjustified sub-ranges (reg 0x202/2, reg 0x1002/4) and sub-minsize queries (ram 0x2000/1, reg 0x200/1) return true; out-of-extent (reg 0x208/4) and foreign-space queries at numerically coincident offsets return false through the in-justifiedContain space guards (fspec.cc:269 for the aligned entry, address.cc:133 for exclusions), and unique has no entry at all

cases.setup: join ParamEntry (pieces MS-first reg:0x104 high + reg:0x100 low, min4) followed by plain reg [0x200,0x207] min4 exclusion force-left, NO populateResolver
cases.expect: join entries ARE reachable: reg 0x100/4 hits the low piece (join walk offset 0) and reg 0x104/4 hits the high piece (walk offset 4 >= 0 — possibleParam accepts any non-negative containment, unlike findEntry just=true == 0); reg 0x100/8 (walk -1, pokes out of both pieces against the plain entry too) and reg 0x102/4 (pokes out) return false; the plain entry hit returns true; a stack query is rejected by the per-piece address.cc:133 guard

cases.setup: join ParamEntry with pieces in DIFFERENT spaces (MS-first ram:0x200 high + reg:0x200 low, min4), NO populateResolver
cases.expect: the reg query hits the low piece (offset 0 -> true); the ram query walks the foreign low piece (address.cc:133 -1, +4 skip) into the containing high piece (cur=0) and returns offset 4 >= 0 -> true; reg 0x204 is outside both pieces; reg 0x200/8 pokes out of the low piece with the high piece foreign -> -1 -> false; a stack query meets only foreign pieces -> false

cases.setup: ParamListStandard with six entries: reg [0x100,0x11F] min2 alignment 8 smallsize-zext; join reg:0x204+reg:0x200 min2 smallsize-sext; ram [0x2000,0x200F] min2 exclusion smallsize-inttype; reg [0x3000,0x3007] min2 exclusion smallsize-sext; reg [0x4000,0x4007] min2 exclusion zext|inttype; reg [0x5000,0x5007] min2 exclusion inttype|sext
cases.queries: 13 rows: ae spc/off/sz -> opcode (+ res space:0xoffset/size for non-COPY)
cases.expect: fspec.cc:366-394 with the list wrapper cc:1426-1437: justified small values extend with the whole-alignment container (reg 0x100/2 and 0x108/2 -> INT_ZEXT res register:0x100/8 and 0x108/8); the exclusion entry passes back the whole entry (ram 0x2000/4 -> PIECE res ram:0x2000/16); the cc:377 justifiedContain call is SPACE-AWARE — a stack query at a numerically justified offset returns COPY (fspec.cc:269 route), a stack query on the exclusion entry returns COPY (address.cc:133 route); unjustified offsets (0x102/2, ram 0x2002/4) return COPY; the sz gates return COPY (reg 0x100/8 sz>=alignment); the list minSize skip (cc:1431) returns COPY for reg 0x100/1; the join entry returns COPY at cc:376 even though its low piece justifies reg 0x200/2; flag precedence zext > inttype > sext (0x4000/2 -> INT_ZEXT, 0x5000/2 -> PIECE, 0x3000/2 -> INT_SEXT res register:0x3000/8)

observation_schema.format: 39 fixed-order UTF-8 lines with final newline: one envelope, four case headers, then 10 pp rows, 6 pp rows, 5 pp rows and 13 ae rows
observation_schema.branches: pp rows print possibleParam's true/false; ae rows print get_opname and, for non-COPY only, the res container (space:0xoffset/size) — res is never read on the COPY paths (Ghidra leaves it unwritten)
observation_schema.classification: opcodes COPY/INT_ZEXT/INT_SEXT/PIECE (get_opname prints without the CPUI_ prefix on both sides)

decisive_semantics.references_and_outputs: possibleParam returns bool, no state mutation; assumedExtension writes res (VarnodeData&) ONLY after passing the cc:377 != 0 gate — COPY paths leave res untouched on both sides; the list wrapper returns the first non-COPY entry's opcode
decisive_semantics.loop_bounds_traversal_order: possibleParam (cc:1769) and assumedExtension (cc:1430) both iterate entry.begin()..entry.end() in list order with no space/minSize prefilter (only the cc:1431 getMinSize() > size skip inside assumedExtension's loop); the join walk (cc:253) runs pieces from least significant (numPieces()-1) to most
decisive_semantics.counters_and_accumulators: the join walk accumulator res (cc:252) adds vdata.size only for pieces the query does not contain (cur < 0, including the address.cc:133 foreign-space -1) and returns res + cur on the first containing piece; assumedExtension's alignAdjust (cc:385) is computed per call from (addr.getOffset() - addressbase) % alignment
decisive_semantics.sort_and_comparison_keys: possibleParam's acceptance key is justifiedContain >= 0 (NOT == 0 — unjustified containment qualifies); assumedExtension's gate is justifiedContain == 0 exactly; space equality keys are per-piece address.cc:133 (joins), fspec.cc:269 (alignment!=0) and address.cc:133 via the entry Address (alignment==0); the smallsize flag precedence is zext (cc:389) then inttype (cc:391) then sext (cc:393)

residuals.detail: Both A46 residual-3 call sites are space-aware and oracle-pinned: ParamListStandardOut::possible_param iterates all entries through justified_contain_in_space (join entries reachable, >= 0 acceptance), ParamEntry::assumed_extension threads query_space into the cc:377 gate (foreign-space numerically-justified query -> CPUI_COPY).
BE-space rows: the enum AddressSpace model is little-endian-only, so big-endian justification arithmetic (address.cc:138 off1-off2 branch) stays unreachable through these callers.

Remaining spaceless justified_contain callers after this fix: ParamListStandard::unjustified_container (cc:1411, fspec.rs call at the unjustified_container body) and ParamListStandard::fillin_map's two trial queries (cc:1382-1410). Need their own space-threading + fixture (root to register).

build.ghidra_build: Archive the locked decompiler C++ tree and rebuild libdecomp.a with the recorded host compiler; fixture links libdecomp.cc + sleigh_arch.cc + inject_sleigh.cc + whole-archive libdecomp.a
build.rugra_build: Archive the pinned base, overlay the owned fspec source, verify the complete Cargo.lock registry closure, then let /usr/bin/cargo --locked --offline select and checksum the current Linux target's cached packages under the global build lock.
